title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 3/2026 of the European Union for the financial year 2026 – Adjustments in expenditure, update of revenues and other technical updates
part_text: 2. Takes note of the exceptionally high amount of competition fines included in Draft amending budget No 3/2026; opposes the use of such exceptional revenue to finance new expenditure or to increase the Union’s budgetary capacity; considers that such revenue should benefit Member States, in particular through a reduction in their GNI-based contributions, rather than serve as an additional source of funding for the Union’s budgetary ambitions;
